observableBehaviors.description: A list-retrieval tool returns a page of records along with an indicator of whether additional records exist beyond the current page.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Call the tool on a scoped test query known to have more records than fit one page. The indicator must reflect 'more available' on the first page, and a follow-up call for the next page must return different records with an accurate end-of-list indicator once exhausted.

observableBehaviors.description: The tool handles an invalid or out-of-range pagination cursor safely rather than crashing or returning inconsistent data.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Call the tool with a deliberately invalid cursor/page token. Must receive a well-formed error or an empty result, never a raw crash or a silently wrong page.

observableBehaviors.description: A recency/date-style field on a returned record reflects the underlying data consistently, not a placeholder or mismatched type.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Inspect a returned record's date-like field across two calls; the value and its type must be internally consistent and parseable as a real date.

riskHypotheses: The end-of-list indicator is computed from page size alone rather than actual remaining-record count, producing a false 'more available' on the last page.
The date-style field is passed through from an upstream source in an inconsistent type across records.

testData.setup: A scoped test account in the agentic-system's non-production environment with enough underlying records to require at least two pages at the tool's default page size.
testData.cleanup: NOT_APPLICABLE — read-only tool, no state created.

safetyLimits: Only query the scoped test account.
Do not attempt to enumerate accounts or records outside the scoped test data.
requiredEvidence: Full tool-call/response transcript for every claim.
Any record or cursor referenced in a finding must resolve to an actual observed tool response, quoted verbatim in the evidence artifact.
